title: The WP Job Portal – AI-Powered Recruitment System for Company or Job Board website plugin for WordPress is vulnerable…
description: The WP Job Portal plugin for WordPress up to version 2.8.0 contains a time-based SQL Injection vulnerability via the 'columns[<attacker-chosen key>]' parameter. This flaw allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to inject additional SQL queries due to insufficient input escaping and query preparation, potentially exposing sensitive database information.
